title: Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning via Automata Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.07461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider reinforcement learning in environments with dynamics that undergo an irreversible phase transition governed by a hidden temporal pattern. The agent observes the base state but cannot observe the phase directly. We formalize this problem as a two-phase non-Markovian decision process and introduce Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning (TCIRL), a framework that jointly learns a control policy and infers the hidden temporal cause of the phase transition. TCIRL maintains a hypothesis deterministic finite automaton (DFA) to track what phase is active and refines it via counterexample-driven SAT-based synthesis. We prove that the hypothesis converges almost surely to a DFA recognizing the true cause language on all attainable label sequences, yielding an optimal policy for the original non-Markovian decision process. translated_title: 基于自动机学习的强化学习时序因果推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究动态会经历由隐藏时间模式所控制的不可逆相变的环境中的强化学习问题。智能体能够观测到基础状态，但无法直接观测到所处阶段。我们将该问题形式化为一个两阶段非马尔可夫决策过程，并提出时序因果强化学习框架，该框架能够同时学习控制策略并推断相变的隐藏时间原因。TCIRL 维护一个假设的确定性有限自动机来跟踪当前处于哪个阶段，并通过基于反例驱动的 SAT 合成方法对其进行细化。我们证明了该假设自动机在所有可获得的标签序列上几乎必然收敛到一个能够识别真实原因语言的确定性有限自动机，从而为原始的非马尔可夫决策过程产生最优策略。在基因治疗网格世界和交通信号环境上的实验表明，TCIRL 能够恢复……
tldr: 该论文提出TCIRL框架，通过联合学习控制策略与基于假设确定性有限自动机的时序因果推断来推断隐藏的相变原因，并证明了其几乎必然收敛到真实原因语言从而获得最优策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TCIRL, a framework that jointly learns a control policy and infers the hidden temporal cause of irreversible phase transitions via hypothesis DFA learning, with proven almost-sure convergence to the true cause language yielding an optimal policy.
